defects.summary: Worker loss during EA compilation could leave active work with no deterministic recovery contract.

defects.summary: Interrupted result parsing could strand an active job or cause an unnecessary repeat of MT5 execution.

defects.summary: Round evidence used multiple writes that could expose partial or inconsistent files as complete.

Separate 108-request Windows process-counter profile (qualified route mocked) measured CPU 1.0781s, peak working set 64,405,504 bytes, read I/O 6,060,864 bytes, write I/O 0; profile boundaries and cleanup limitation are recorded in .workflow/acceptance.json.

defects.summary: MT5 Strategy Tester could enqueue excessive local-agent work without MAX-owned hardware-aware admission, causing CPU/RAM pressure and optimizer failure.
defects.evidence: PR #15 bounded Owner-PC Stage C/D plus later CUSTOM requested 6/resolved 5 evidence confirm that MAX now enforces a bounded local-agent process cap. The newer long Owner attempt exposed a distinct virtual-memory/commit-pressure admission gap tracked separately as OPTIMIZER-MT5-COMMIT-PRESSURE-ADMISSION-GAP.

defects.summary: Optimizer admission can remain physically-RAM-safe while Windows virtual-memory/commit pressure becomes unsafe during a real long Owner run.
defects.evidence: Newer Owner runtime after PR #15: CUSTOM requested 6/resolved 5 and local Core 01-05 were active, but Windows Event ID 2004 reported low virtual-memory/commit pressure and MAX ended with OPTIMIZER_RESOURCE_PROCESS_QUERY_FAILED. Observed terminal64 working set was ~13.8 GiB and MetaTester processes ~12.0 GiB and ~7.1 GiB; recorded commit limit was ~48 GiB with ~13.1 GiB pagefile. Current source records total/available virtual memory but resolve_resource_preflight and frozen_resource_admission gate on available_ram_bytes; the Owner-hardware per-agent estimate (~2.86 GiB) materially underestimated observed MT5 usage. Mixed-DIMM topology is not proven causal; no WHEA, Windows Memory Diagnostic, or Defender evidence established hardware or antivirus as the cause.
